idea-plugin.name: Codex Tabs
idea-plugin.description:
Keep independent Codex and Claude Code conversations in native editor tabs. Split chats beside your code and see which tasks need your attention.

  • Stream replies, commands, file changes, and generated images.
  • Create shared Git worktrees with native diffs and terminals.
  • Use slash commands, skills, context inspection, and immediate turn steering.
  • Edit earlier messages, preview attachments, and restore chats and drafts.
  • Work with local projects or Windows projects backed by WSL.

Requires IntelliJ IDEA 2026.1 or newer with JCEF and a current Codex CLI or Claude Code CLI. Each provider uses its own CLI sign-in. The plugin has no separate cloud service and does not ask for an API key.

Setup and usage · Report an issue

idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.12 adds Claude Code, provider switching, and Mermaid diagrams.

  • Use Claude Code with streamed replies, tools, approvals, models, effort controls, session history, and shared project guidance.
  • Switch idle chats between Codex and Claude while keeping conversation text, drafts, and the selected checkout.
  • Remember the last selected provider for every new chat in the project, including split tabs and chats started from files.
  • Render Mermaid diagrams in chat with zoom and source views.
  • Copy just the conversation as Markdown by default, or include tool activity from the Copy menu.
  • Improve provider menus with icons, clearer spacing, and richer status and error colors.
  • Fix Claude startup on macOS when multiple Node installations are present, and explain unsupported CLI startup failures.
